dealSummary: VC DEALS The Boring Company, a startup specializing in underground tunneling owned by Elon Musk, is in talks to raise a $4 billion round at a $20 billion valuation, The Wall Street Journal reported.
Spanish AI startup Multiverse Computing secured a $570 million Series C led by Forgepoint Capital International, BNPP SIVF and Bullhound Capital at a $1.7 billion valuation.
leadInvestors: Forgepoint Capital International, BNPP SIVF, Bullhound Capital

dealSummary: Antares, a developer of nuclear microreactors for defense and space applications, raised a $470 million Series C led by Paradigm and Caffeinated Capital which included $370 million in equity and $100 million in debt.
leadInvestors: Paradigm, Caffeinated Capital which included $370 million in equity, $100 million in debt

dealSummary: German space tech specialist The Exploration Company is in talks to raise at least $300 million at a $2 billion valuation, the Financial Times reported.
Budapest-based digital insurance provider Ominimo received a Series B led by EBRD at a $1.6 billion valuation.
AI research lab Prentis, which trains AI models on office work, is in talks to raise a $100 million round at a $1 billion valuation, TechCrunch reported.
Virginia-based Flourish Health, which provides in-home mental healthcare, raised a $26 million Series A led by B Capital, F-Prime and Cherryrock Capital.
Way Security, an identity access management startup, raised a $20 million seed round led by Insight Partners and Glilot Capital.
Nuclear Turbines, a UK-based developer of compact nuclear power systems, raised £15 million in a round led by IQ Capital.
